name: Abhinavagupta
summary: Polymath systematiser of Trika/Kaula/Krama/Pratyabhijna (fl. c. 975-1025): Tantraloka, Tantrasara, IPV/IPVV, Paratrimsika exegesis, early stotras.
bio: Polymath systematiser of Trika, Kaula, Krama and Pratyabhijna (fl. c. 975-1025): the Tantraloka encyclopedia, its Tantrasara distillation, two Pratyabhijna commentaries (IPV/IPVV), the Paratrimsika exegesis, and early stotras. Pupil of Lakshmanagupta (Pratyabhijna/Krama), Sambhunatha (Kaula), Bhutiraja and some twenty teachers across sects; never married, devoted to Siva after early family loss. Our site rests on his corpus.
